summary: Completed comprehensive testing of new Bulk Product Import feature. All 9 pytest tests pass. Verified CSV template download, bulk import with semicolon/comma delimiter auto-detection, preview page, confirm import, and image auto-match functionality. Existing product CRUD operations work without regressions.

issues: APP_URL is set to HTTPS in .env but PHP built-in server runs HTTP - this causes HTTPS redirect issues during testing. Not a production issue since production uses proper web server with HTTPS.

passed_tests: Products page shows 'Bulk importeren' button with data-testid='bulk-import-btn'
CSV template download works - returns semicolon-delimited CSV with UTF-8 BOM
Bulk import page renders with all required elements (download-template-btn, csv-file-input, preview-import-btn)
CSV upload with semicolon delimiter shows preview page with product data
CSV upload with comma delimiter auto-detects correctly (Google Sheets format)
Confirm import creates products in database
Image auto-match: Product with image_name='test-image-1.jpg' got image_id=3 after uploading matching image to media library
Single product creation via /client/products/create still works (no regression)
Products list page loads correctly with data-testid='products-list'
seed_data_creation: Test products created during testing: 'Test Product 1/2/3' via bulk import, 'Import Test Product' via pytest, 'CRUD Test Single Product' via pytest. Auto-match test: uploaded 'test-image-1.jpg' to media library which got linked to 'Test Product 1'.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Bulk import feature fully tested. Uses PHP built-in server (php -S 0.0.0.0:8080 -t public) for local testing. APP_URL in .env is HTTPS but local testing uses HTTP - use allow_redirects=False in requests to avoid SSL issues. All Blade views have proper data-testid attributes. CSV parser auto-detects delimiter (semicolon vs comma). Image auto-match works via MediaController::store() which updates products with matching image_name. SQLite database at /app/laravel-app/database/database.sqlite.
